title: Garrison / Overview
description: Health of the Garrison control plane and workers: runs, REST traffic, capacity, cost, and recent problems. Start here.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Garrison node: the server pod or container name, or the worker node name.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: Tenant ID. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: harness
list.label: Harness
list.description: Harness type. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

panels.title: Control plane replicas up
panels.description: Server pods (or containers) Prometheus scraped successfully.

panels.title: Workers up
panels.description: Worker metrics endpoints Prometheus scraped successfully.

panels.title: Leader elected
panels.description: 1 when one control-plane replica holds leadership. Without a leader nothing reaps leases or enforces deadlines.

panels.title: Runs executing
panels.description: Runs in progress on the selected workers.

panels.title: Runs waiting
panels.description: Runs waiting for a worker, cluster-wide.

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Free run slots
panels.description: Free run slots across the selected workers.

panels.title: Garrison versions running
panels.description: Processes reporting each Garrison version (garrison_build_info), by process.

targets.expr: count by (version, process) (garrison_build_info{node=~"$node"}) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "version", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Label values folded
panels.description: Measurements whose label value became other because a label reached Telemetry.MaxLabelValues. Non-zero means a busy label, such as agent, needs a higher limit.

panels.title: Label values folded by label
panels.description: Which labels hit the cardinality guard.

panels.title: Runs created
panels.description: Runs created in the selected range.

panels.title: Runs finished
panels.description: Runs that reached a terminal status in the selected range.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs that finished with any outcome other than Succeeded.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{outcome!="Succeeded", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Success rate
panels.description: Share of finished runs that Succeeded over the selected range.

targets.expr: sum(increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{outcome="Succeeded", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__range])), 1) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Run time p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of queued to completed over the averaging window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="total", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time to first model output over the averaging window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="first_token", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Runs created by agent (per minute)
panels.description: Invocations per minute, by agent.

targets.expr: sum by (agent) (rate(garrison_runs_created_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Runs finished by outcome (per minute)
panels.description: Terminal runs per minute, by outcome.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "outcome", "none", "", "")

panels.title: REST requests by status class (per second)
panels.description: Requests per second handled by the REST listener, by status class.

panels.title: REST latency
panels.description: Median and 95th percentile REST request duration.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Tokens per minute by direction
panels.description: Tokens consumed by finished runs, by direction (input, output, cached, reasoning).

targets.expr: sum by (direction) (rate(garrison_run_tokens_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "direction", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Cost per hour (USD)
panels.description: Reported or estimated cost of finished runs per hour, by agent.

targets.expr: sum by (agent) (rate(garrison_run_cost_usd_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$window])) * 3600 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Failed runs by outcome
panels.description: Runs that did not succeed, by outcome. NotCredentialed, NotInstalled, and McpPreflightFailed point at configuration.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{outcome!="Succeeded", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "outcome", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Lease expirations and guard trips
panels.description: Runs whose worker stopped renewing the lease, and runs stopped by a guard.

targets.expr: sum by (guard) (increase(garrison_runs_guard_trips_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "guard", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Errors and rejections
panels.description: REST 5xx responses, authentication failures, and database errors per minute.

panels.title: Recent warnings and errors
panels.description: Warning and error lines from the server and workers.
